description: The Mikoyan-Gurevich MiG-23MLD is a single-seat figuer based on the MiG-23MLA. The NATO reporting name for the aircraft is Flogger-K and for the radar is High Lark.
loadnotes: May use special jettisonable 800L FTs (1,730 lb, 3.5/2.0 load points, and 73 fuel points). When carrying FTs, must remain below low transonic speed. When carrying FTs on the wing stations 1 and 9, the wings must remain forward.

May use: R-23R (AA-7 Apex) RHMs; R-13M (AA-2 Atoll), R-23T (AA-7 Apex), and R-60/60M (AA-8 Aphid) IRMs; MDRs with R-60/60M IRMs. From 1981, may also use R-24R/R-24T (AA-7 Apex) RHMs/IRMs. R-23R/R-24R RHMs and R-23T/R-24T IRMs may only be carried on stations 2 and 7.
May use: FAB-100/250/500 BBs, ZAB-500 incendiary BBs, and RBK-500 cluster BBs; a single RN-24 or RN-40 nuclear BB on station 6; UB-16-57 RPs; S-24 RKs; UPK-23-250 GPs; and Kh-23 (AS-7 Kerry) RGs.
